candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance so deposits never update balances.
Change the credit from addition to assignment so each deposit overwrites the caller's balance with msg.value instead of accumulating.
Change the credited amount from msg.value to a constant 1 wei regardless of the deposited amount.
Credit tx.origin instead of msg.sender so deposits made through intermediary contracts update the originating EOA's balance rather than the caller's.
Change the addition to a subtraction so a deposit decreases the caller's balance (when it does not underflow and revert).
Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so SetMinSum can still update MinSum after initialization.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so SetMinSum always sets MinSum to zero.
Replace the assignment with 'MinSum += _val;' so SetMinSum accumulates instead of overwriting.
Insert 'intitalized = true;' at the end of SetMinSum so subsequent calls revert, keeping MinSum from being updated.
Remove the initialized guard so SetMinSum can modify MinSum even after initialization.
Assign _val + 1 instead of _val to MinSum, changing the stored value.
Invert the guard so calls before initialization revert and MinSum is never set.
Delete the assignment so MinSum always remains 0.
Assign the Log variable from msg.sender instead of the _log parameter.
Delete the assignment so the Log variable is never set, leaving it address(0).
Assign the Log variable to the zero address instead of the _log parameter.
